label: synthetic fixture workload; not real usage

environment.topology: API, benchmark client and PostgreSQL on one host over loopback; one sequential client

catalog_text_search.what: GET search, text mode over all types, limit 20

catalog_browse.what: GET search, empty query (browse) over records, limit 20

catalog_id_lookup.what: GET search by 8-character id prefix over all types

bounded_lineage.what: GET entity lineage-graph, both directions, depth 4, max 200 nodes, from a product

cost_aggregation.what: POST audit-questions: cost of two products (shared runs counted once)

event_display_lag.what: commit of a revision until GET activity returns it (API drains the outbox on read)

notes: Latency is measured at the owner HTTP API, not in a browser; screens add their own polling interval on top (the Overview screen polls every 4 s).
One sequential client: no concurrent-user load was measured.
Seeded through the audited store and fixture broker; costs are simulated nano-USD.
